newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Maraven to raise output to 1.5 mln bpd.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Maraven to raise output to 1.5 mln bpd.

text.p: Venezuelan state-owned oil company PdVSA affiliate Maraven plans to almost double production to 1.5 million barrels per day (bpd) over the next ten years, company president Emilio Abouhamad said.

Seventy percent of the company's $15 billion investment programme "will go towards increasing our production capacity from current levels of 900,000 bpd to 1.5 million," he told reporters. Sixty five percent of that expansion will be in association with private partners, he added.
Maraven, which has traditionally operated in Venezuela's oil heartland at Lake Maracaibo, signed a $2.5 billion deal with Chevron in December to place heavy crudes and asphalt on the U.S. market.
